headline: Assets of Kazakhstani Banks Grew by 6.9% Over Eight Months
summary: Assets of Kazakhstani banks increased 6.9% over the first eight months of 2026, to 75.6 trillion tenge ($165.8 billion), according to the agency's chairperson.
why: Bank asset growth is a key indicator of credit expansion and financial-sector health in an economy, relevant to investors in Kazakhstan's banks and the tenge.
